name: Competitions
description: Run private, card-based competitions with submissions, reviews, scores, and leaderboards.

store.tagline: Run private challenges and celebrate the best work.
store.description: Competitions helps organizers run invitation-only challenges from one place. Create challenge cards with clear requirements, collect text, links, images, or pull-request proofs, review each entry, and score competitors on a shared leaderboard. People only see challenges they were invited to.
